title: AlgoVoi VCS addon manifest
description: Describes an addon wheel for the Verifiable Archive engine: what it implements, which engine version it targets, and where the wheel lives. Schema version 1: wheel_url now requires wheel_sha256, URLs must be https, and the $id carries the version. Version strings are validated as a PEP 440 release-shaped subset (epoch, release, pre, post, dev, local), not by a full PEP 440 parser.

name.description: Distribution name of the addon wheel.

kind.description: Which engine extension point this addon implements.

engine.description: The engine distribution and version range this addon was built and tested against.

entry.description: Dotted path to the implementing class, for example 'mypkg.backend:MyBackend'. The module must be import-safe without the provider SDK installed.

requires.description: Extra pip extras that must be installed for this addon to work, for example ['mypkg[aws]'].

notes.description: Free text: custody versus storage semantics, network requirements, tested versions.

wheel_url.description: Direct URL to a published wheel, if the addon is distributed outside an index. Must be https: an index entry that resolves over plaintext installs whatever the network returns.

wheel_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the wheel named by wheel_url. Required when wheel_url is set, so a manifest binds the addon to exact bytes rather than to a URL.
